title: Common providers: Mexico
coverage: Partial. Covers the national carrier, the three mobile network operators, the main cable and fibre operators, the shared wholesale mobile network and the university network; business ISPs and regional cable operators are thin.
missing: Regional cable operators and wireless ISPs
Business ISPs beyond Axtel, Bestel and Flo Networks
The state operator CFE Telecomunicaciones e Internet para Todos (its pages did not answer on the read date)
An AS number for Flo Networks (none registered in Mexico was found)
Websites for Telmex, Telcel, Totalplay, izzi, Bestel and Megacable (they did not answer an automated request on the read date)
The regulator's register is a search application: it could not be read as a list

sources.name: CRT (Comisión Reguladora de Telecomunicaciones): public register of concessions
sources.terms: No reuse licence was found on the page read on the read date, so nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date (the former regulator's register address leads to it). It is a search form, not a list. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Mexico and 5 more pages
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names and former names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 9 of 13 entries were found by a name on the 6 pages read.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 7 of 13 websites and 0 support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider or a company the entry names.
sources.result: 18 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: RIPE NCC list of AS names
sources.terms: No licence statement was read: used only to find candidate AS numbers, each then confirmed as above; nothing is copied.
sources.result: Read to find which AS numbers are registered under each provider's company names.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0: no conditions. The item id of a provider is recorded as a stable cross-reference.
sources.result: 1 entries carry the id of a Wikidata item that states one of the entry's AS numbers (property P3797).
